# scripts/UI/Settings.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/UI/Settings.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Lazy persistent HUD settings in user://settings.cfg; setters save immediately.
path and reload() let tests isolate their config. Unknown/missing awareness_marks values default to true.

Base: `RefCounted`. Registered class: `none`.
